_meta.for: triage-error: generate failure_code criteria from the LIVE versioned catalog at call time; this is a starter shape

failure_code.instructions: Select the most specific failure code established by the supplied diagnostic evidence. Classify the observed failure mechanism; do not invent an upstream root cause. Use no_match when no catalog definition is supported.

criteria.transport_extension_failure: An extension or tool wrapper failed before reaching its own logic (missing path, module, or config).
criteria.provider_timeout: An upstream model or API call exceeded its deadline.
criteria.provider_rate_limited: An upstream returned 429/529 or equivalent backoff signal.
criteria.schema_validation_failure: A payload failed schema or contract validation.
criteria.dependency_missing: A required file, credential, service, or collection is absent.
criteria.silent_no_op: The component reported success but the effect is verifiably absent.
criteria.no_match: No listed failure code is established by the evidence.
